Memory

✦♡✿♡✦

To my favourite person ♡

three years of us

Three years. Somehow that sounds both incredibly long and nowhere near long enough to hold everything that has happened between the beginning and now. When I look back, I do not think of one perfect moment. I think of all the little adventures that we went on, all the memories that we made and keep so close to our hearts.

I think that is one of my favourite things about us. We never needed every moment to be huge for it to matter.You have a way of making the small things feel worth remembering.

Then there are the little things that stayed with us afterwards: the Polaroids, the butterfly necklace, the frog plush and the growing little family of gifts. None of them are important because of what they cost or what they are. They are important because each one carries a moment, a joke, a day, or a version of us that I never want to completely forget.

That is why I made this little world for you. A normal photo gallery did not feel like enough. I wanted you to travel through our memories, stop at each little chapter, and end somewhere far enough away to show how much these three years have come to mean to me. The Earth, the Moon and the giant heart at the end are dramatic, obviously, but the real point is much simpler: I am really grateful that I got to share all of these moments with you.

I do not know exactly what every next chapter will look like, and I think that is part of what makes it exciting. I just hope there are many more ordinary days, stupid pictures, favourite foods, tiny gifts and memories that make no sense to anyone except us.

Happy 3rd anniversary. Thank you for three years of memories I would choose all over again. ♡

MY LOVE FOR YOU IS EVEN GREATER THAN EARTH.
